title: Surface-sensitive spectrometry: new insights into radical reactions at interfaces
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, 28,1276-1287
DOI: 10.1039/D6EM00197A, Paper
Zachary R. Schiffman, Yuekun Yang, Barbara J. Finlayson-Pitts, Lisa M. Wingen
Gas-phase HO2 and RO2 radicals compete for surface-bound radicals to control oxidation product distributions on organic particles, revealing that the surface chemistry of atmospheric aerosol is fundamentally coupled to gas-phase radical composition.
